description: Returns the open issues Opservo has detected on one server, ranked by severity (critical, warning, info), each with a plain-English description and the suggested fix. Can be filtered to one severity.

severity.description: Optional: only return recommendations at this severity.

name: get_recommendations

error.description: Present only when the call failed: why, in plain English (unknown server, server from another workspace, not a Kubernetes cluster).

category.description: Area: performance, security, storage, reliability, database and so on.

description.description: What was detected and why it matters.

fix.description: Suggested fix, usually with the command in backticks.

title: Server issues and recommendations
